description: This Java class 'AverageAngles' calculates and reports statistical analysis (mean, standard deviation, and differences) of angle data collected at different RPMs. It processes angle events, generates reports, and manages angle data over multiple charts.

classes.name: AverageAngles
classes.description: Main class for calculating average angles, storing angle data per RPM, and generating reports.

classes.name: AverageAngles.AngleEvent
classes.description: Inner class representing a single angle event with its angle and signal.

methods.name: AverageAngles()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AverageAngles object and clearing previous data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns a report string summarizing the angle analysis.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds angle data for a specific RPM from a line of input, skips if RPM change is too large or data is invalid.

methods.name: printReport
methods.description: Outputs the statistical angle data report to the provided Appendable stream.
